caption: The drawing features a geometric chandelier rendered in shades of black, gray, and beige. The main perspective at the center shows a four-armed hanging fixture with a central vertical rod, attached to a circular hook at the top. Four thin, elongated candles are positioned at the ends of each arm, each held upright in a square base. Chains run diagonally from each candle base to the top section of the rod, forming a stabilizing network. Above the central rod, a polygonal, faceted shade with ribbed detailing encircles the chandelier horizontally. Two additional diagrams appear below: one is a top-down view showing the symmetrical, cross-like arrangement of the components with a scale in inches, and the other a side view showing the distribution of chains, the flatness of the shade, and the alignment of the candles. The drawing is set on a plain, lightly tinted paper, and the artist's name, Mildred Ford, is written in the bottom right corner.
title: Candelabrum
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
